note: Author matching cases, run through the production classifyPaper(). `matchIndex` is the index of the byline author the owner was matched to (-1 = not found); `matchedAuthor` is the text of that author (a merged span when the name is written in reversed order); `roles` is asserted only when present.

cases.note: full display name, middle of the byline
cases.authors: Hao Tang, Ningfeng Que, Yanwen Tian

cases.note: full display name, first in the byline
cases.authors: Ningfeng Que, Hao Tang, Yanwen Tian

cases.note: abbreviated given name with a full stop
cases.authors: Yujia Sun, N. Que, Peiting Shi

cases.note: abbreviated given name without a full stop
cases.authors: Yujia Sun, N Que, Peiting Shi

cases.note: reversed order inside a comma separated byline is read as one author
cases.authors: Hao Tang, Que, Ningfeng, Mingzhe Li
Hao Tang, Que, N., Mingzhe Li
Hao Tang, Que Ningfeng, Mingzhe Li

cases.note: middle initial that the profile does not show

cases.authors: Yujia Sun, N. F. Que, Peiting Shi

cases.note: Chinese alias (阙宁峰) inside a Chinese byline with full-width commas
a paper the owner is not on
cases.authors: Yujia Sun, Peiting Shi, Yin Dai

cases.note: near miss must never match: different given name and surname

cases.authors: A. Smith, B. Jones, et al.

cases.note: different author ending in the same letter as a surname must not match
diacritics: profile name with umlauts, byline without
cases.authors: H. Schmidt, Z. Muller, K. Weber

cases.note: diacritics: byline with umlauts, reversed order
single author paper written in reversed order
